topic: The Phantom Frequency: Curiosities of Ghost Radio, Unexplained Acoustics & Sonic Relics

changelog.summary: Launched an interactive daily-updating archive of mysterious radio broadcasts, deep-ocean anomalies, and acoustic ghosts with an interactive Web Audio signal synthesizer.
Added audio output gain slider, demodulation mode switcher (AM/USB/LSB), copy telemetry coordinates with toast, phonetic cipher decoder reference tool, and CRT scanlines visual effects.
